QuestInfo.name: Maple BigWigs Title (Legendary)
QuestInfo.0: Word around town is that people are getting special titles being part of the Maple BigWigs! Find out if it's true.
QuestInfo.1: Your rank in the Maple BigWigs is set as Legendary, so you can get a title of that rank!
QuestInfo.2: You got a Maple BigWigs Legendary rank title!

0.0: Congratulations! You've been selected to be a part of the exclusive Maple BigWigs! I have a small gift for you for your loyalty to MapleStory. Would you like to accept it now?

no.0: That's fine. You can claim your gift anytime by clicking the Quest Notifier button.

yes.0: My files tell me that you've been selected for the Maple BigWigs Legendary rank! I have the perfect title for you, right here in this filing cabinet. I've placed it in your Set-up tab!
